title: Streamline launch changelog draft, cross-team review and distribution plan
creator: Sofia Patel
description: Goal: produce a dual-format launch changelog (concise customer-facing summary + detailed internal technical digest), run a 72-hour stakeholder review window, and finalize distribution assets (help center article, release email, console banner). Scope: collect PR summaries, regression/fix notes, any behavioural changes to existing APIs, explicit rollback guidance, and known issues. Deliverables: 1) canonical Confluence changelog draft, 2) customer-facing changelog markdown for website and email, 3) internal digest with migration notes for Support/SEs, 4) release checklist and distribution schedule. Success criteria: signoff from Eng, Design, Security (if required), and GTM; asset published on release date; no high-severity surprises called out by Support in first 48 hours.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical changelog doc created and linked in ticket
Design approval on customer-facing language and screenshots
Support/SEs briefed with internal digest and Q&A
Distribution artifacts (email + help center + console copy) scheduled and staged
All links to PRs and metrics dashboards included
checklist: Create canonical changelog page in Confluence
Gather PR links and summary lines from ENG owners
Draft customer-facing blurb and executive summary
Assemble internal digest with migration steps and rollback notes
Run 72-hour review with ENG/DES/SEC/GTM and collect signoffs
Finalize assets and hand off to Growth for scheduling
Publish and monitor first 48h for regressions/feedback

notes: Trade-offs discussed: condensed review window (72h) reduces launch friction but increases chance of missed edge cases — mitigations: owner templates, Slack triage channel, and 48h post-launch monitoring. We will iterate on review cadence based on retrospective.

risk_and_mitigation: Risk: Technical migration steps are missed leading to customer confusion — Mitigation: include step-by-step migration in internal digest and link to sample code snippets.
Risk: Growth needs more time for copy/A-B tests — Mitigation: provide two pre-approved subject lines and prioritize audience segments for first wave.
Risk: Post-release bugs show up in first 48h — Mitigation: on-call pager rotation, dedicated Slack channel, and runbook with rollback criteria.
